observations.text: The speaker repeatedly attempts to replace phone use with push-ups as a habit.
observations.quote: Every time you reach for your phone, instead of reaching for your phone, what are you going to do? Push-ups.

observations.text: The speaker expresses a desire to improve their behavior but struggles with self-sabotage.
observations.quote: I can't even slip up and just... I can't even fail my way to failure.

observations.text: The speaker believes they should not start a business from a position of weakness or desperation.
observations.quote: You don't start a business from a position of weakness. You don't start a business out of a position of desperation.

observations.text: The speaker states they need 300 leads for their business, currently at 100.
observations.quote: At about 30 per table, 300 leads I would find totally acceptable. We're at 100 now, I think we can get to 300 before the 15th.

observations.text: The speaker uses 'I genuinely believe' repeatedly to emphasize conviction.
observations.quote: I genuinely believe, I genuinely believe. I genuinely believe.

observations.text: The speaker claims to believe they should kill themselves but states they don't actually do it.
observations.quote: I should 1000% kill myself. I just don't.

observations.text: The speaker refers to a former co-worker named Adrian Coldworn.
